THE POWER OF

Interior Design

Transform your space with our Full Interior Design Services, offering comprehensive support and guidance from conceptualization to final execution. Create a seamlessly designed and cohesive environment with our range of services.

Paula Pérez

Principal Designer

Paula’s approach to design is inspired by a passion for creating environments that are both beautiful and enhance the well-being and lifestyle of those who inhabit them. She believes every space has a story to tell, and her goal is to help clients tell theirs in the most authentic and inspiring way. Paula collaborates closely with her clients to grasp their unique needs and translate them into spaces that let those personalities shine.

Her diverse background and experiences exploring different cultures, lifestyles, and materials have enriched her design perspective. This open-minded approach informs her philosophy, enabling her to create vibrant, cohesive spaces that become the setting for unforgettable family moments.

As a Suffolk University graduate, Paula has a solid foundation in design principles, spatial awareness, and the technical skills needed to bring creative visions to life.

Let Paula help you create something amazing!

INTERIOR DESIGN

Service

In our commitment to transforming spaces into captivating works of art, RG now proudly offers full interior design services. Our expert team will work with you to understand your vision, providing everything from detailed floor plans and samples to high-quality renderings and space planning. Guided by a meticulous evaluation of your space’s layout, functionality, and flow, we bring our expertise to curate materials and finishes. This ensures each element harmonizes to create visually stunning interiors.

Based in Rhode Island, we are dedicated to bringing our comprehensive interior design services to clients throughout Massachusetts and Rhode Island. Clients trust us to infuse their spaces with creativity and sophistication. Whether you’re seeking a fresh perspective for your home or business, RG is here to bring your vision to life. We’ll guide you through every step of the process, ensuring that your design goals are met with stunning results.

OUR

Process

STEP 1: Meet & Brainstorm

Our journey begins with a thorough consultation where we discuss your vision, needs, budget, and timeline. We meet in person or virtually to understand your preferences, lifestyle, functionality and the specific requirements for your space. We visit your location to take accurate measurements and assess the existing conditions. We then share inspiration boards and brainstorm ideas.

STEP 2: Concept & Space Planning

We created an initial design concept that includes mood boards, color schemes, and preliminary layouts. You’ll receive visual representations of the proposed designs and provide feedback to refine the concept.

STEP 3: Project Execution

Finally, our team manages all aspects of the installation process, coordinates with contractors, craftspeople and vendors. We keep you informed as your space transforms into a captivating work of art.
